text: むし　ポケモン　いがいで　いいの　いないかなーって　さがして　るん　だけど…

structure.jp: むし　ポケモン　いがいで
structure.en: among ones other than Bug Pokémon

structure.jp: いいの　いないかなーって
structure.en: thinking 'I wonder if there are any good ones'

structure.jp: さがして　るん　だけど…

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と and wraps up what the speaker is thinking. いないかなーって = 'thinking, I wonder if there are any'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows an action going on right now, and てる is its shortened spoken form. さがして　る = 'am looking'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど means 'but', and leaving the sentence hanging on it hints that things aren't going as hoped. さがして　るん　だけど… = 'I'm looking, but...'.
